stories.title: Week 7 live: Indiana, Ohio State locked in defensive battle
Sources: Eagles QB Hurts, out indefinitely with blood clot, not planned for IR
stories.summary: The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely with a superficial blood clot.

stories.title: Commanders RB Croskey-Merritt out vs. 49ers with groin injury
stories.summary: Commanders running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt won't play against the 49ers because of a groin injury, coach Dan Quinn said.

stories.title: Source: Patriots likely to activate WR Brown for Sunday's game vs. Jets
stories.summary: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is likely to be activated after missing the past four games with a right high ankle sprain, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: No. 1 pick Dybantsa to have ankle checked after leaving preseason finale
stories.summary: First overall pick AJ Dybantsa exited the Wizards' preseason finale after injuring his ankle on an awkward landing and will undergo further evaluation.
